reason: For a small task, 33 USDC all-in plus the work of writing a rubric and checking entries is more than I would pay one freelancer I can vet myself. I also have to explain USDC on Solana to whoever signs off my spend, and I can't do that for an unaudited product.
objection: I'm accountable for every dollar. Paying a 10% fee plus a reward that is only paid if entries clear a bar, in crypto, on an unaudited product run by one person, is hard to justify when a freelancer would do a small task for less and I can ask for a sample first.
would_change_my_mind: An independent audit, a few real reviews from other organisations, and a way to pay by card with no crypto wallet. A free first task would get me to try it once.
